messages:
Anya: heads-up — on iPhone SE I keep triggering the sidebar peek when trying to swipe table rows horizontally for actions. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/peeking.png :grimacing:
Samuel: repro steps? device/OS/browser?
Anya: iOS 16 safari, narrow viewport ~360px. Table has horizontal scroll for truncated cells, swipe left -> intended row actions. But our global gesture for sidebar peek kicks in from left edge and steals it.
Martin: saw a little uptick in mobile "back"/gesture errors in analytics last week, could be same cause.
Lina: accessibility nit — when sidebar snaps in it steals focus from the table row actions which breaks keyboard/voiceover flow. Also hit targets feel <44px on some rows.
Samuel: makes sense. Two quick ideas: (1) scope the sidebar edge-gesture to a smaller edge zone (eg 12–16px) and (2) add `touch-action: pan-y` to the table container so horizontal pans are allowed inside the table. I'll try both.
Ryan: also, while we're here, can we change the action label from "Details" to "Open panel" on mobile? It's clearer when the panel covers content. Small copy tweak.
Anya: +1 on copy. For breakpoints I think the sidebar should become a modal at <=420px; below that we should 1) reduce peek width to 20% of screen and 2) disable edge-swipe if table has horizontal scroll.
Samuel: quick snippet I'll test:
```css
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .console-table { touch-action: pan-y; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
  .sidebar-edge-zone { width: 16px; }
}
```
Samuel: also going to tweak our gesture lib threshold from 30px -> 12px for edge-only triggers and add a check: `if (element.closest('.has-horizontal-scroll')) cancelSidebarGesture()`
Anya: sounds good. Can we add a visual affordance for the peek (thin handle) so users know where to swipe?
Lina: visual affordance helps but ensure it has accessible name and is focusable. Eg `<button aria-label="Open sidebar" class="peek-handle">` and hit target >=44x44.
Martin: can we schedule a quick playtest after the change? 10-15m with a phone — want PM + Design + Frontend + Accessibility in call.
Samuel: I'll open a draft PR and tag you all. PR: https://git.redwood/PR/4256 (WIP) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Anya: thanks — leaving a small design note in the doc with two screenshots and suggested copy.
Ryan: thanks team :raised_hands:
gesture-bot: automation note — deployed a dev build including touch-action tweaks to staging (build 2026.03.18-88)
Samuel: will test on staging and update the thread with results.
Anya: if staging looks good, let's ship the copy tweak with the same PR.
Lina: one more a11y check — after changes can we run VoiceOver quick pass and update the checklist?
Samuel: yep, adding to PR checklist.
Anya: ok, marking as in-progress. Appreciate the fast turn on this. :eyes:
